name: Armor Swap
author: glawks
description: Oozla armour vendor-style in-game overlay, Triangle interaction and cosmetic armour selection.

settings.name: Visible armour
settings.description: Fallback for saves without an in-game cosmetic selection. Changes in the Oozla popup are stored with each game save.

settings.name: Vendor position X
settings.description: Test centre of the interaction area on Oozla (can be set in-game with L3+R3+Triangle).

settings.name: Vendor interaction radius
settings.description: Only Triangle inside this many in-game units from the chosen bars will open the vendor.

settings.name: Show Oozla test coordinates
settings.description: Displays player X/Y/Z and distance to vendor trigger, for placement testing.

settings.name: Allow on-site placement
settings.description: On Oozla, L3+R3+Triangle sets the interaction centre at Ratchet's position.
